en.question: You are rolling out an agent that can modify production configuration. Which deployment approach is safest?

options.text: Enable it for everyone at once so real failure modes surface quickly.
options.note: Maximum exposure before anyone knows the failure modes.

options.text: Restrict it to overnight windows when production traffic is at its lowest.
options.note: A quiet window reduces witnesses rather than risk, and breakage is caught later.

options.text: Grant full autonomy from day one but log every action for later tracing.
options.note: Logs support diagnosis after harm; they prevent nothing.

options.text: Start in proposal-only mode with human approval, then widen autonomy.

en.explanation: Progressive autonomy: the agent proposes and a human disposes, real behaviour is measured, and the permission boundary widens only where evidence supports it. Blast radius grows deliberately.
